metadata.description: Let Claude Code watch videos: Instagram reels, TikToks, YouTube, X and local files.

plugins.name: reel-watch
plugins.description: Let Claude watch a video. Paste an Instagram reel, TikTok, YouTube, X link or a local video: it downloads it for free, breaks it down on your computer (Whisper transcript, OCR of every screen, a local model for the summary) or has Gemini watch it if you add a key, and writes down the exact tools, links and commands it shows.
